title: Constituent Assembly
definition: A sovereign body of elected representatives tasked with drafting the Constitution of India, functioning as both a constitution-making body and a provisional parliament.
importanceInUpsc: Fundamental to understanding the constitutional evolution of India, the legitimacy of the Indian state, and the transition from colonial rule to a sovereign republic.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Constituent Assembly.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
